title: Rho reveal
description: Wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it 14px as it enters the window; an optional step number staggers cards in a row.
notes: CSS scroll-driven (animation-timeline: view()); without support, or with reduced motion, content shows in place
name: rho-reveal

props.name: step
props.description: stagger step: 0 arrives first, 1 a little later, and so on
